title: Python: imaplib STARTTLS serves plaintext bytes buffered before the handshake as if they came over TLS (CVE-2026-115559)
description: A vulnerability in Python's imaplib library prior to version 3.16.0 allows plaintext bytes buffered before the STARTTLS handshake to be misinterpreted as TLS-protected data. This can enable a network attacker to inject forged IMAP responses after the STARTTLS command, potentially misleading the client about server capabilities and command completions.
